attributes.name: Tibetan Spaniel
attributes.description: The Tibetan Spaniel is a small breed of spaniel from Tibet. These dogs are small in size, with a short and silky coat of fur. They have a cheerful and affectionate demeanor, making them excellent companion dogs. They are highly trainable and intelligent, with an instinct to protect their family and property. They are loyal and devoted to their family, but can be stubborn and independent at times.

attributes.name: Schipperke
attributes.description: The Schipperke is a small breed of dog from Belgium. These dogs are small in size, with a thick double coat of fur. They have a lively and energetic demeanor, with an instinct for hunting and tracking. They are highly intelligent and trainable, but require firm and consistent training to be obedient. They are loyal and devoted to their family, but can be stubborn and independent at times.

attributes.name: Dalmatian
attributes.description: The Dalmatian is a medium-sized breed that originated in Croatia. They have a short, dense coat, and come in a variety of colors. They are an active and energetic breed, and need plenty of exercise and mental stimulation. They are loyal and devoted to their owners, and make good family companions.

attributes.name: Bulldog
attributes.description: Bulldogs are a strong, stocky breed with a short, smooth coat. They have a wide head and a thick neck, with a short muzzle and deep-set eyes with a determined, friendly expression. Bulldogs are known for their courage and tenacity and are a popular pet thanks to their even temperament and friendly, loyal nature.

attributes.name: Löwchen
attributes.description: The Löwchen is a small, active breed with a short, wavy coat. They have a small, wedge-shaped head with large, dark eyes and a lively expression. The Löwchen is a playful, loyal breed that loves to be around its family and is known for its eagerness to please and its lively, friendly nature.

attributes.name: Poodle (Standard)
attributes.description: The Standard Poodle is a large and graceful dog breed from Germany. They are intelligent, active, and loyal, and make great family pets. Standard Poodles have a thick, curly coat that can be any color. They are easy to train and require plenty of exercise and mental stimulation to stay healthy and happy.

attributes.name: Chow Chow
attributes.description: The Chow Chow is a medium-sized breed of dog that originated in China. It is an independent and loyal breed that is known for its distinctive blue-black tongue. The Chow Chow stands between 17-20 inches at the shoulder and has a dense, long coat that can come in various colors.

attributes.name: Coton de Tulear
attributes.description: The Coton de Tulear is a small, fluffy breed with a cotton-like coat that is soft and hypoallergenic. It is known for its friendly and playful personality.

attributes.name: American Eskimo Dog
attributes.description: The American Eskimo Dog is a small to medium-sized breed with a thick, fluffy coat that comes in white, cream, or biscuit colors. It is known for its intelligence and its ability to learn a wide variety of tricks.

attributes.name: Boston Terrier
attributes.description: The Boston Terrier is a small, intelligent dog breed that originated in the United States. They are known for their friendly dispositions and distinctive black and white coats.

attributes.name: Shiba Inu
attributes.description: The Shiba Inu is a small and agile breed of dog that was originally bred in Japan for hunting small game. They are intelligent, independent, and alert, and make excellent companion dogs.

attributes.name: Lhasa Apso
attributes.description: The Lhasa Apso is a small and playful breed of dog that was originally bred in Tibet as a companion dog. They are intelligent, independent, and affectionate, and make excellent family pets.

attributes.name: Chinese Shar-Pei
attributes.description: The Chinese Shar-Pei is a large and muscular breed of dog that was originally bred in China for guarding and protecting property. They are intelligent, loyal, and protective, and make excellent guard dogs.

attributes.name: Keeshond
attributes.description: The Keeshond is a medium-sized breed of dog that was originally bred in the Netherlands for guarding and protecting property. They are intelligent, friendly, and playful, and make excellent companion dogs.

attributes.name: Norwegian Lundehund
attributes.description: The Norwegian Lundehund is a small and agile breed of dog that was originally bred in Norway for hunting puffins. They are intelligent, playful, and energetic, and make excellent companion dogs.

attributes.name: Tibetan Terrier
attributes.description: The Tibetan Terrier is a small and playful breed of dog that was originally bred in Tibet as a companion dog. They are intelligent, affectionate, and loyal, and make excellent family pets.

attributes.name: Finnish Spitz
attributes.description: The Finnish Spitz is a small and agile breed of dog that was originally bred in Finland for hunting small game. They are intelligent, energetic, and determined, and make excellent hunting dogs.

attributes.name: Poodle (Miniature)
attributes.description: The Miniature Poodle is a small and agile breed of dog that was originally bred in Germany for hunting waterfowl. They are intelligent, friendly, and eager to please, and make excellent companion dogs.

attributes.name: French Bulldog
attributes.description: The French Bulldog is a small and playful breed of dog that was originally bred in France as a companion dog. They are intelligent, affectionate, and loyal, and make excellent family pets.

attributes.name: Xoloitzcuintli
attributes.description: The Xoloitzcuintli, also known as the Mexican Hairless Dog, is a small and intelligent breed of dog that was originally bred in Mexico for hunting and guarding. They are loyal, alert, and affectionate, and make excellent companion dogs.

attributes.name: Bichon Frise
attributes.description: The Bichon Frise is a small and playful breed of dog that was originally bred in France as a companion dog. They are intelligent, affectionate, and loyal, and make excellent family pets.
